name: Midas mTBILL
oneLiner: mTBILL is Midas's NAV-accreting Treasury-bill fund token, with disclosed USTB and BUIDL positions and portfolio-level NAV reporting.
collateral: Treasury-bill fund portfolio with issuer-reported USTB and BUIDL positions and an explicitly unclassified residual. The transparency source reports rounded position values and a source timestamp; these are portfolio estimates, not independently examined holdings.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting token (not pegged to $1); price launched at ~$1.00 and appreciates continuously as T-bill yield accrues; permissioned mint/redeem at daily NAV via Midas smart contracts in USDC/USDT or fiat; on-chain NAV reporting

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (MiFID II financial instrument); EEA-passported; not available to U.S. or UK retail persons
